pool.text: Mughal emperor Akbar reached Patna to crush the rebellious Afghan Chief Daud Khan.
The Portuguese sent in traders, establishing a factory in Patna at least.
The English East India Company established a factory in Patna for trading.
Peter Mundy described Patna as the greatest mart of the eastern region.
Mughal Emperor Aurangzeb renamed Patna as Azimabad while Prince Azim was subedar.
Siraj ud-Daulah revolted and seized Patna before surrendering and receiving forgiveness.
The sewerage system in Patna was set up.
The All India Radio Patna was established as Akashvani Patna Kendra.
Magahi Parishad pioneered Magadhi journalism in Bihar.
Asia's longest river bridge, the Mahatma Gandhi Setu, was built in Patna.
The Patna Regional Development Authority was dissolved.
The World Bank ranked Patna second in India for ease of starting business.
Six people were killed in a series of coordinated bombings at a rally.
Thirty-three people were killed in a stampede at Gandhi Maidan during celebrations.
The Bihar government built a state-of-the-art landmark museum in Patna.
The Patna Metropolitan Area Authority was established as the superseding agency.
Eptisa Servicios de Ingenieria SL of Spain was chosen as project management consultant.
The Sabhyata Dwar was built with Mauryan-style architecture and completed.
Tata Consultancy Services started operations at a new Patna facility.
The Taj Hotel Patna at Budh Marg Lodipur finished construction.
